caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-length dress with long sleeves and no head, hands, or feet visible. The dress appears to be made of a light fabric patterned with a repeating small floral or leafy motif in a dark color against a lighter background. The dress features a fitted bodice with a high, closed collar and a waistband accentuating the waist. The skirt is full and pleated, falling to the floor, and is finished with a ruffled hem. The sleeves are voluminous at the shoulders and taper to the wrists. The overall color scheme of the drawing is monochromatic, primarily shades of gray and black, with detailed shading providing a sense of texture and fabric folds. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations.
